Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The diff includes parent PR #1817. It changes rest toolpath generation and adds a CL golden.

Checks that passed:
- The controls change the page draft. Apply uses the command door. The UI tests cover Apply, refusal, undo, redo, and unit conversion.
- The body has before and after screenshots. The images load. Their commit is on the fork's `pr-screenshots` history.
- I read all 128 lines of `pocket_rest_corners.cl`. The file adds 126 moves at Z 20, 18, and 16 mm. The golden comparison and stock test pass. No existing golden or snapshot PNG changes.
- No dependency, `build.rs`, `scripts/`, or `.github/` change is in this diff.

Local results:
- The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `a277dd9d51e7b4488403b946d0a3234b71ba7504` failed in `crates/app/tests/level_links.rs`. I aborted the merge. All results below are for the PR head, not a merged tree.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed. The full quick gate was not run.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- App `rest_pocket`: 6 passed, including the golden and stock tests.
- App library `rest_op_tests`: 1 passed.
- Motion `rest2d`: 10 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- UI library, with CWD `crates/ui`: 818 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored release snapshots.
- Two local mutations failed as expected. Without switch-off clearing, the toggle test failed at `rest_pocket_tests.rs:239`. Without the inline strategy warning, the warning test failed at `rest_pocket_tests.rs:280`. Both mutations were removed. All 5 rest UI tests then passed. The working tree is clean.

Expected mutation failures:
```text
rest_pocket_tests.rs:239:5:
assertion `left == right` failed: turning switch off clears draft rest to None
rest_pocket_tests.rs:280:5:
consequence warns when Zigzag is active with rest machining
```

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/params_page.rs:142`: Make the Auto note use the rest strategy when the draft has rest machining on. The after-on screenshot says `Auto -> Zigzag`. But `rest_strategy(Auto)` always selects Waterline. The page thus names a strategy that the generator does not use, and that explicit rest machining refuses. Show the Waterline choice and add a structural assertion for this state.
2. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:142`: Include the required increase in `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` for this process-file change. The current diff adds the skill row but does not change the version file. The root AGENTS.md requires both changes in the same PR. If the parent supplies this change first, check the remaining diff after the parent merges.
3. `crates/app/tests/level_links.rs:250`: Resolve the merge conflict before merge and test the resulting tree. Keep the parent-first order stated in the body. Refresh this branch at merge time, as the project rules require. Current main removed the round-trip block that this PR changes to add `rest: None`; do not restore that block without checking the main-side change.

Notes:
- The parent decision record names the entry and cleared-floor limits tracked by #1490 and #1816. Those limits are not new findings here.
- No GitHub runner or workflow was used. No code, evidence, or image was committed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Stopped under the requested same-logic conflict rule. No changes were committed or pushed. The head remains 9567d3a8df70ffb352663474ed8e7370c3225231.

1. The Auto note still needs the rest-strategy Waterline choice and a structural assertion. No pin or mutation check was completed.
2. The review requests a PROCESS_VERSION bump for the skill row. The fixer instructions forbid editing that file. The current resolve-conflicts skill also assigns the bump to the merging session. No version edit was made.
3. `git merge upstream/main` conflicts in `crates/app/tests/level_links.rs`, at the `roundtrip` helper and `links_round_trip_and_the_defaults_write_no_key` block (PR line 250). This branch adds `rest: None` to the Pocket initializer. Main moved that test into `crates/app/tests/level_links/choices.rs` in da5862cd3dc77545eae19fa7a71a5aae0cb4f751 and now has the `to_tri` helper at the conflicting location. This is a refactor that moved code the branch edited. I aborted the merge rather than restore the old block or guess at the resolution. Parent-first order remains unchanged.

The quick gate and clippy were not run. No new head exists. Please re-review this conflict report before another fixer attempt.

Addressed: No findings were fixed. The required same-code conflict rule stopped this attempt.

1. The Auto note still needs the Waterline choice and a structural assertion. No pin or mutation check ran.
2. The requested PROCESS_VERSION edit is prohibited by the fixer instructions. The current rules assign the bump to the merging session.
3. The merge with upstream/main at af83da0f405cfd244f0c9bf8192ab7309e9db824 conflicts in crates/app/tests/level_links.rs, near PR line 250. The conflicting block contains roundtrip and links_round_trip_and_the_defaults_write_no_key. This branch adds rest: None to its Pocket initializer. Main moved the test to crates/app/tests/level_links/choices.rs in da5862cd3dc77545eae19fa7a71a5aae0cb4f751. Main now has to_tri at the old location. I aborted the merge under the required stop rule. The worktree is clean. Parent-first order remains unchanged.

No commit or push occurred. The head remains 9567d3a8df70ffb352663474ed8e7370c3225231. The quick gate and clippy did not run.

Please re-review the conflict report before another fixer attempt.

Fixed the latest review findings on `6284d9cd99bf4602fdadab482269f822a8241b04`.

1. **Pocket Auto note (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/params_page.rs`):** Added `pocket_auto_note`. When draft `rest` is `Some`, it queries `camcraft_app::machining2d::rest_strategy(PocketStrategy::Auto)` and shows `Auto -> Waterline: rest machining cuts concentric rings along each rest area.`. Pinned by `egui_app::rest_pocket_tests::rest_group_auto_note_shows_waterline_when_rest_is_on` (mutation check: reverting `params_page.rs` failed at `rest_pocket_tests.rs:337`, restoring passed all 6 `rest_pocket_tests`).
2. **`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` / `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`:** The skill row belongs to parent PR #1817, not PR #2093. Per `AGENTS.md`, PRs never edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` (`Process change: yes` is already in #1817's body, and #1817 is `merge-ready` at `7c23d7496`). PR #2093 touches no process files.
3. **`crates/app/tests/level_links.rs` conflict:** Merged updated parent PR #1817 (`origin/issue/1489-rest-pocket-param` at `7c23d7496`, commit `596b9f261`) into this branch. Parent #1817 already took main's `level_links.rs` split and carried `rest: None` into `crates/app/tests/level_links/choices.rs` and `crates/app/tests/first_router_part.rs`. Parent-first order is preserved (`7c23d7496` is an ancestor of HEAD), `git merge-tree` with `upstream/main` is clean, and `app::level_links` (25 passed) passes in the quick gate.

Checks on `6284d9cd99bf4602fdadab482269f822a8241b04`:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed (`motion` 1607s, `app` 2048s, `ui` 68s; 3 steps, 0 failed).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

New head sha: `6284d9cd99bf4602fdadab482269f822a8241b04`. PR remains a draft and labels are unchanged.

Please re-review.
